1479-5700-5701-6662-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6662-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3518-4284-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

574-1003-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
574-1003-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-1003-5006-8170.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1170-2829-5131-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

1887-4050-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-4050-5254.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Repeat.

1912-2033-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2033-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2783-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2783-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1718-3327-4613-7940.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-7940.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2781-6626-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3330-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

618-3110-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {R} due to Council of the Absolute.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1247-1528-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cabal Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-3277-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3277-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1247-3918-7434.description:
Activate Trazyn using Brass Infiniscope's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
1247-3918-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

140-3245-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-1618-2056-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
80-1618-2056-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2056-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2438-2906-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2438-2906-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2084-7317.description:
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {7}{U}, causing a player to draw five cards and create a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1308-2457-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1491-2033-6218-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2292-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1669-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

729-1170-1329-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2478-2866-4986-5330.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1921-4659-4894.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Breaching Hippocamp token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Breaching Hippocamp token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

3062-3484-5391-6291.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3062-3484-5391-6291.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot and a tapped 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Robot and Thopter enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

654-1170-1645-5954-6751.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-5295-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

500-1809-2081.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Returned Pastcaller and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Returned Pastcaller tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1323-3990-4687.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G/U}.
1323-3990-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1995-2136-6252.notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Gauntlets of Light attached to Orthion.
1995-2136-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {12}{R}{R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
1995-2136-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1115-1270-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

774-2653-3147.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2292-4053-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2292-4053-5944.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2617-4613-5231-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2617-4613-5231-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping it.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1912-3076-4474-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
1912-3076-4474-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1283-2781-4499.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

413-851-1480-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Squirrel Mob.
You control at least one additional creature.
413-851-1480-3828.description:
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Squirrel Mob.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enter the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens and Blasting Station triggers.
Activate Blasting Station's first ability by tapping and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.

1750-2575-4903-5261.description:
Cast the extra turn spell and move to your extra turn.
Activate Isochron Sceptre to cast Pull from Eternity, putting the extra turn spell from exile to your graveyard.
Attack with Backdraft Hellkite to give your extra turn flashback, then cast it.
Repeat for infinite turns.

2757-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping the Dog token, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time, tapping Whitemane Lion instead.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger from step 3, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
